title: 第十章 杂交动物
slug: 恶毒雌性玩的花兽世大佬排队跪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

姜枝：谢邀。

五个已经凑够烦恼了，她正想着怎么离婚，各走各路，可别再来一个狐狸。

而且这位腰细腿长桃花眼的美男子，看着就不太像正经兽人。

姜枝正要走人。

狐兽人却忽然靠近了些，压低声音道：“你前几日让我拿的那个东西，我已经拿到了。怎么样，要不要？”

姜枝脚步一顿。

“什么东西？”

狐兽人眨了眨眼，笑得更暧昧了。

“就是当初首领送给大祭祀的物件，我可费了不少功夫，才从祭祀那里弄出来。她宝贝得很，平时都不怎么离身。”

“你想要的话，今晚来我洞里啊。”

姜枝眼皮跳了一下。

好家伙。

又是争风吃醋。首领到底有什么魅力，送给别人的礼物原身都想偷过来。

姜枝沉默两秒，果断开口：“我改主意了。”

狐兽人一愣：“什么？”

“那个东西我不要了。你从哪里拿的，就放回哪里去。”

她现在只想远离麻烦，连自家五个兽夫都不想要，哪还有心情抢别人的暧昧信物？

狐兽人却轻轻笑了一声，骚红色的大尾巴缠绕了上来。

“姜枝，你今天可真奇怪。”

姜枝正琢磨怎么全身而退，忽然听见前头“砰”的一声闷响。

斧头狠狠劈进木头里，力道重得有点过头。

姜枝下意识抬头。

不远处的空地上，堆着半人高的木柴。

几个兽人正分散着劈木头、削木桩，还有人在处理兽骨和猎皮，忙得热火朝天。

而其中最扎眼的那个，几乎不用认。

苍凛站在最里侧，手里握着石斧，肩背绷得很紧。

他今天上身照旧没怎么遮，伤口好了大半，宽阔后背随着动作一收一放，肌肉线条绷得利落又性感。

“砰——”

又是一斧子下去。

那截木头直接裂成了两半。

苍凛从头到尾都没看姜枝，像压根没注意到她从这边经过。

可姜枝又莫名觉得，他肯定看见了。

想到这儿，姜枝拂开了狐狸的尾巴，心里竟生出一点说不清的心虚。

……等等。

她心虚个什么劲？

她和苍凛本来就准备离婚，昨晚那也纯属酒后意外，还是你情我愿，严格来说甚至算一次友好交流。

大白天多看两眼帅哥，捏捏尾巴，那不是人之常情吗？

再说了，这地方帅哥是真多。

穿得还真少。

不看白不看。

不摸白不摸。

姜枝刚把自己说服，前头又是“砰”的一声。

这一次更狠。

木屑都溅起来了。

旁边一个正捆柴的熊族兽人都忍不住偏头看了苍凛一眼，嘴里嘀咕了一句：“你今天跟木头有仇？”

苍凛没说话。低着头，眉骨压得很沉，薄唇绷成一条线，手背青筋微微凸起，抓着斧柄的手收得死紧，像是多用一分力，那柄石斧都能被他生生捏裂。

Page (1/3)

Jiang Zhi: Thank you for the invitation.

The five of them were enough troubles. She was thinking about how to get divorced and go their separate ways without another fox coming.

Moreover, this handsome man with slender waist and long peach blossom eyes does not look like a serious orc.

Jiang Zhi was about to leave.

The fox-orc man suddenly came closer and lowered his voice: "I've already got the thing you asked me to get a few days ago. How about it? Do you want it?"

Jiang Zhi paused.

"What?"

The fox orc blinked and smiled even more ambiguously.

"It was the object that the leader gave to the high priest. It took me a lot of effort to get it from the priest. She is very precious and never leaves her body."

"If you want, come to my cave tonight."

Jiang Zhi's eyelids twitched.

Good guy.

Jealousy again.What is the charm of the leader? He wants to steal the gifts he gives to others.

Jiang Zhi was silent for two seconds and then said decisively: "I changed my mind."

The fox orc was stunned: "What?"

"I don't want that thing anymore. Just put it back where you took it from."

She just wants to stay away from trouble now. She doesn't even want her five beastmen, so how can she be in the mood to snatch other people's ambiguous tokens?

The fox-orc man laughed softly, and wrapped his big red tail around him.

"Jiang Zhi, you are really weird today."

Jiang Zhi was just thinking about how to escape, when he suddenly heard a muffled "bang" in front of him.

The ax struck hard into the wood, a little too hard.

Jiang Zhi subconsciously raised his head.

In the open space not far away, there was a pile of firewood half as high as a person.

Several orcs were splitting wood and cutting stakes, and some were busy processing animal bones and hunting skins.

And the most eye-catching one is almost unrecognizable.

Cang Lin stood at the far end, holding a stone ax in his hand, his shoulders and back tense.

He still didn't cover much of his upper body today, and his wounds were mostly healed. His broad back moved up and down with his movements, and his muscle lines were tight and sexy.

"Bang——"

Another blow with the ax.

The piece of wood split into two halves.

Cang Lin didn't look at Jiang Zhi from beginning to end, as if he didn't notice her passing by at all.

But Jiang Zhi felt inexplicably that he must have seen it.

Thinking of this, Jiang Zhi brushed away the fox's tail, feeling a little unexplainable guilt in his heart.

……etc.

Why is she guilty?

She and Cang Lin were planning to divorce, but what happened last night was purely a drunken accident. It was still consensual. Strictly speaking, it was even considered a friendly exchange.

Isn't it human nature to look at handsome guys twice in broad daylight and pinch their tails?

Besides, there are so many handsome guys here.

Very little clothing.

If you don’t see it, you won’t see it.

If you don’t touch it, you won’t touch it.

Just as Jiang Zhi convinced himself, there was another "bang" in front of him.

This time it's more brutal.

Sawdust splattered.

A bear orc who was tying firewood next to him couldn't help but turn his head and glance at Cang Lin, and muttered: "Do you have a grudge against the wood today?"

Cang Lin said nothing.His head was lowered, his brows were heavy, his thin lips were stretched into a line, the veins on the back of his hands were slightly raised, and the hand holding the ax handle was tightened, as if he could crush the stone ax with just a little more force.
